title: Every ticker list in the UI shows its BUY/HOLD/SELL signal
description: User request: all lists must show the BUY/HOLD/SELL signal, even the watchlist. WatchlistTable (frontend-watchlist-page, merged) already does this via common/SignalBadge -- no change needed there, confirm it still holds. The actual gap is the Portfolio-domain tables: PositionsTable (Portfolio page) and PositionsGlanceTable (Dashboard page) show ticker/quantity/price/P&L but no signal today, since GET /api/portfolio never returned one -- api-portfolio-position-signal (depends_on) adds it. Add a Signal column to both tables using the exact same common/SignalBadge treatment WatchlistTable already established (reuse, do not reinvent), with the same null-signal '—' fallback pattern WatchlistTable uses. Decide whether RiskPanel's table should also get a signal column (it currently shows risk-driven exit_flags, a different concept from a fresh entry signal -- both could usefully coexist) and record as a decisions entry either way.

checklist.step: Add a Signal column (common/SignalBadge, null-safe) to PositionsTable.tsx (Portfolio page), reusing WatchlistTable's exact pattern.
Add a Signal column (common/SignalBadge, null-safe) to PositionsGlanceTable.tsx (Dashboard page), same pattern.
Decide whether RiskPanel's table also gets a signal column, and implement if so; record the decision either way.
Confirm WatchlistTable's existing signal display still works unchanged (regression check only, no code change expected there).
Update/add tests for each changed table's new column (MSW-mocked, including the null-signal case).
Confirm 90% coverage gate still holds; run make e2e to confirm nothing broke on the Portfolio/Dashboard pages.
